Players Committee card image of [[Director Orson Krennic]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your control phase, if with opponent's Undercover spy, opponent loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). While at a site, opponent may not cancel or modify your battle destiny draws here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/directororsonkrennic.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
